immigration.text: She condemned workplace immigration raids and advocated protections for immigrant workers, families, and communities.
immigration.quote: The ICE raids that began in Los Angeles last week, and what has been happening since January across the country, is not only unjust, but also cruel.

abortion.text: She explicitly described California's position on abortion rights as unwavering while promoting expanded reproductive-care coverage.
abortion.quote: Infertility and IVF coverage in large group health plans, combined with our unwavering stance on contraception and abortion rights, solidifies California as the nation’s leader in reproductive freedom.

gender.text: She coauthored AB 1955, which prohibited school policies requiring staff to disclose a student's gender identity without permission.
gender.quote: The signing of AB 1955, the SAFETY Act, comes nearly one year to the date after Superintendent Thurmond was forcibly removed from a school board meeting after speaking during public comment to oppose a proposed forced outing policy that LGBTQ+ students and families had said would threaten students’ safety at school and at home.

health.text: She defended health coverage for undocumented adults and made expanding access to health services a stated priority.
health.quote: As the former Senate Health Committee Chair, I made expanding access to health services a priority. I fought to protect health access to undocumented adults because I know we have so many mixed-status families, and often the burden to financially support a family land on the documented kid.

energy.text: She called for a faster transition away from oil while pairing it with green jobs and economic protections.
energy.quote: The truth is, we are moving away from oil because it’s harmful and outdated, and the faster we transition, the less leverage this industry has over our policy decisions.

tax.text: Rodriguez calls for lower taxes and fees and an end to spending on programs he considers unsuccessful.
tax.quote: The frivolous spending of taxpayer dollars on failed programs must end.

housing.text: Rodriguez says single-family neighborhoods should be protected from state policies and outside developers.
housing.quote: There must be allowances for all kinds of neighborhoods in a state as big as California. Single family neighborhoods are under threat by corporate buyers, Sacramento and out-of-state developers.

schools.text: Rodriguez said parents should choose which participating accredited school receives their child's taxpayer-funded allocation.
schools.quote: Parents should decide which participating and accredited school should receive the 15,000 of taxpayer monies allocated per student;

safety.text: Rodriguez calls for fully funding police and adding more officers.
safety.quote: Public safety must be a priority, and to do this, we must fully fund the LAPD and LAFD. More cops, more firefighters, fewer excuses.
